reason: Research was limited: two WebSearch queries returned no reliable 2026-11-05 recap of the selloff and no outlook for the week of 11-09; the results were from other years, so I am deciding on the packet and the desk brief, not on confirmed market detail. The book is mostly cash after four stop-losses (SOXL, TQQQ, QQQ, MU) and holds only SHV at 5%. The packet's own strategy is leveraged semiconductor and mega-cap tech momentum, and the stops fired in exactly the chip and tech names the strategy depends on. Re-entering 3x leveraged chip or Nasdaq exposure now, into a selloff I could not verify and with the stops still fresh, would be chasing the same trade that just failed. A full rebuild would also cost real basis points and add new leveraged risk. Holding cash at 4% APY and SHV is the disciplined choice until the tape shows a clear reversal that I can verify.
